about: Build scripts in the graphs of the harness apps (harness/apps/apps.json) that corpus.json does not pin at the same version, with what harness/v2/pure_scripts.py expects of each (the same words as corpus.json). The local apps' scripts come from their Cargo.lock and were read at those versions in the crates.io source on 2026-10-30 (`seen: registry`); the cloned apps' own scripts are from memory (`seen: memory`). A script listed nowhere is expected from its resolved build dependencies (cc or cmake: cc; autocfg, version_check or rustc_version: rustc; pkg-config: pkg-config), else it has no expectation and is reported as such.
